pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against averaging down or pyramiding into consecutive losses within a 15-minute window; scaling in is only permitted when existing positions are at least +$10 in open profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory 5-minute ATR volatility filter and structural liquidity sweep confirmation before order execution; no market entries during the first 5 minutes of high-impact macro data releases.
profit_harvest_threshold: Immediate partial profit booking (50%) at +$10, moving the remaining stop-loss to breakeven + commission to strictly eliminate downside exposure on winning trades.
